basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Leicester, UK. I've recently rediscovered my childhood love for LEGO and am exploring various online communities. In my free time, I enjoy reading science fiction novels and experimenting with clean living practices. I'm single and tend to be online during evenings and weekends. I'm also a big fan of Leicester City Football Club and enjoy discussing matches and team news.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having graduated with a degree in Visual Communications. My knowledge of LEGO comes from my childhood passion, which I've recently rekindled. I'm also self-taught in various clean living practices and enjoy sharing my findings.
